name: Enhanced Adrenal Response System
description: Enhances the adrenal glands to produce elevated adrenaline and noradrenaline on demand — not the uncontrolled flood of a natural fight-or-flight response, but a regulated, sustained surge that can be consciously triggered and maintained. During activation, the user experiences dramatically enhanced strength, speed, pain tolerance, and reaction time — the 'mother lifting a car' response, available at will and sustainable for 5–15 minutes. The crash afterward is severe: exhaustion, trembling, nausea, and emotional volatility lasting 1–3 hours. Crucible Genomics' installation includes cortisol regulation to prevent the adrenal response from causing long-term stress damage. Street versions lack this protection, and chronic users develop adrenal fatigue, cortisol-related health issues, and psychological dependence on the activation state.
source_organism: Synthetic adrenal enhancement factors, Ursus arctos horribilis (grizzly bear, sustained stress-response genes)
procedure: Adrenal gland retroviral modification with neural trigger installation, 3 sessions
expression_time: 3–5 weeks for gland modification; trigger training 1 month
reversibility: Gland modification partially reversible; neural trigger persistent
side_effects: Chronic users develop adrenal fatigue and cortisol imbalances
Accidental activation during nightmares or extreme stress
Emotional volatility during and after activation
Street versions: long-term cardiovascular damage, anxiety disorders, rage episodes
Physical dependency — regular users feel sluggish and depressed without periodic activation
social_perception: Respected in combat and emergency response. Feared in civilian settings — an activated Berserker user is dangerous to everyone nearby. Street-version users are recognizable by their haggard, cortisol-ravaged appearance between activations.
story_hooks: A Berserker Gene user's activation trigger becomes involuntary — any strong emotion triggers the full adrenal surge, making them dangerous during arguments, grief, or excitement
A Tier 1 community's self-defense militia runs on black-market adrenaline mods — they can fight off threats but the long-term health cost is destroying the people they're trying to protect
